scope: Full conversation evaluation with independent source-backed gold; v1 results remain historical development evidence.

gold_sources.graph_computed: Frozen graph, POIs where needed, and independently specified endpoints/activity constraints; the replay runner recomputes exact route legality and full-eligible-set candidate distances. A prefilled candidate ranking in the case file is never trusted as a score.
gold_sources.official_reference: Official dataset case ID and version; benchmark-specific reference must be evaluated by its own scorer or independently mapped to projected outputs.
gold_sources.manual_independent: Reviewer identity and evidence for questions with genuinely ambiguous answers.
gold_sources.draft: Authoring only; never counted as formal task success or failure.

route_reference_contract: For graph-computed gold, a single-turn route may use route_reference. A conversation with more than one turn must use route_references keyed by zero-based turn index for every route turn, including a route after clarification or candidate selection. Formal replay requires frozen POI and graph inputs and verifies stored start/via/end nodes against independently snapped source POIs before scoring; graph agreement does not establish field passability.
sampling: Five groups, eight scenario families per group, three variants per family. A full conversation is one unit. Development and test must have disjoint template, OD, prompt and media-source groups.
scoring: Use the v2 scorer with supplied frozen graph and replay projection. Do not trust product verifier flags or embedded reviews; missing external evidence remains unknown. Tool-call sequence is diagnostic, not the primary endpoint.
route_preservation: A weather-only follow-up with preserve_route_from_turn requires independent client-state evidence that the prior displayed route remains unchanged. A server-only replay cannot establish this; absent independent review is unknown, not success.
formal_gates: per-turn graph route references verified against frozen POI snaps
independently recomputed candidate ranking with unknown access explicitly retained

separate_datasets.O1: 40 official BFCL multi-turn cases retain official IDs and scoring; do not merge their scores into campus T1-T5.
separate_datasets.D1: 24 synthetic road-event tasks with fixed event clock, edge IDs, modes and expiry.
separate_datasets.V1: Six independent source videos mapped to twelve simulated road cases; video is the independent unit.
separate_datasets.V2: 100 labeled VisDrone images for initial detector audit, reported separately from campus data.

status: Protocol implementation in progress; no formal T1-T5 result is claimed by this file.
